attribution.note: Marcus's own sentence in his post. It is not the quoted tweet that follows it.

semantics.note: The proposition correctly gives his present-tense observation that the selloff extends beyond Anthropic to the broad market. There is no numerical threshold.

contract.note: Reading 'whole market' as broad breadth, not literal unanimity, is the ordinary reading and fair. Using the Nov 19 US session plus overnight Asia matches the post's context.

evidence.note: AP report dated Nov 19: the S&P 500, Dow, Nasdaq and Russell 2000 each fell about 2%, and more than 90% of S&P 500 stocks declined. This is direct breadth evidence for the target session.

reviews.rationale: Contemporaneous AP data show broad US declines across all major indices, with more than 90% of S&P 500 constituents falling on Nov 19. That meets the support condition: selling went well beyond Anthropic. No evidence shows the losses were confined to a narrow group. The Asian session isn't independently evidenced in the packet, but the US breadth alone settles the plain reading.

attribution.note: Marcus's own words describing ANT's first trading day.

semantics.note: The proposition captures the first-day open of 111 and close of 97 for public (non-allocated) trading. The qualifier is preserved.

contract.note: The result depends on reading whole-dollar figures as informal approximations. Treating 111 as shorthand for $111.50 (a 0.45% gap) and 97 for $97.17 is an ordinary reading, not a stretch. The contradiction condition requires a material difference.

evidence.note: Yahoo Finance live coverage from Nov 19 reports the opening trade at $111.50, consistent with 'started at 111'.
Report published Nov 20, before the evaluation date, states a Nov 19 close of $97.17, consistent with 'fallen to 97'. The source is less established, but it is specific and consistent with e1.

reviews.rationale: Contemporaneous reporting puts the first public trade at $111.50 and the first-day close at $97.17. Both match Marcus's whole-dollar figures to within immaterial amounts. The exchange's own record wasn't retrieved, but two independent reports agree and no counterevidence was found. Supported on the fair approximate reading.
